newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai offshore bank loans down in Jan over Dec.
newsitem.headline: Thai offshore bank loans down in Jan over Dec.

text.p: The Bank of Thailand said on Monday total outstanding loans extended by offshore banking units fell to 1.20 trillion baht ($46.15 billion) at the end of January from 1.29 trillion at the end of December.
The loans were granted through the Bangkok International Banking Facility (BIBF).

The central bank said the loans brought in from abroad by commercial banks for relending to domestic borrowers (out-in) rose 2.2 percent to 825.2 billion baht at the end of January from 807.6 billion at the end of December.

Cumulative foreign loans of offshore banking units for relending to third country borrowers (out-out) declined 9.1 percent to 438.7 billion baht at the end of January from 482.6 billion at the end of previous month, the bank said.
